purpose: Execute approved GW008 competition key backfill
statements: UPDATE `GW008_IMC Results` SET competition_key=CONCAT('GW008|',sm_country,'|DOMESTIC|league|',sm_division) WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND (competition_key IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_key)='') AND competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND sm_action='league' AND sm_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_country)<>'' AND sm_division IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_division)<>''

UPDATE `GW008_IMC Results` SET competition_key=CONCAT('GW008|',sm_country,'|DOMESTIC|',sm_action) WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND (competition_key IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_key)='') AND competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND sm_action IN ('leaguecup','leagueshield','charityshield') AND sm_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_country)<>''

UPDATE `GW008_IMC Results` SET competition_key=CONCAT('GW008|INTERNATIONAL|',sm_action) WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND (competition_key IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_key)='') AND competition_group='INTERNATIONAL' AND sm_action IN ('smfacup','smfashield','supercup')

UPDATE `GW008_IMC Results` SET competition_key=CONCAT('GW008|NATIONS|',sm_action) WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND (competition_key IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_key)='') AND competition_group='NATIONS' AND sm_action IN ('worldcup','interqualifier')
